C1189.title: Tesla Kubernetes Cluster Breached to Deploy Cryptominer
C1189.summary: In 2018, Tesla's Kubernetes cluster was breached, and attackers exploited misconfigurations to deploy a cryptominer. The incident exposed how K8s console security misconfigurations can lead to compute resource abuse, becoming an early landmark case in cloud-native security.
